2609.28270.title: Predicting Quantization Price for Selecting PTQ Configurations Before Deployment
2609.28270.paper_summary: Weight-space post-training quantization (PTQ) must choose finite formats, granularities, quantizer families, transformations, and bits before the completed quantized model reveals its output-distribution drift. Existing PTQ methods predict important pieces of this degradation, including reconstruction error, Hessian sensitivity, transformation effects, and downstream loss, but these pieces are usually scored after fixing the quantization geometry or inside separate configuration families. We formulate weight-space PTQ as pre-deployment configuration selection using priced layer-output error. Each admissible layer configuration is treated as an error generator with a deployment cost, which induces a layer-output error covariance $\boldsymbolΣ_l(α_l)$, and the full-precision model prices that covariance by downstream curvature, $\widehatρ_l(α_l)=\frac{1}{2}\operatorname{Tr}\left(\widehat{\mathbf{H}}_l\,\widehat{\boldsymbolΣ}_l(α_l)\right)$. The price follows from full-precision-to-quantized forward KL, whose first-order term cancels at the reference model. It turns reconstruction and diagonal scores into reduced proxies that drop price factors, while finite formats, codebooks, granularities, and equivalent transformations become comparable candidates through the covariances they induce and the costs they pay. A trace reduction then yields a calibration-time price table and a budgeted price-guided selector, making fixed-geometry bit allocation a special case rather than the organizing problem.
2609.28270.paper_summary_zh: 權重空間的訓練後量化（PTQ）必須在完成的量化模型揭示其輸出分佈漂移之前，選擇有限的格式、粒度、量化器家族、轉換和位元。現有的PTQ方法預測這種退化的重要部分，包括重建誤差、海森敏感度、轉換效應和下游損失，但這些部分通常是在固定量化幾何或在單獨的配置家族內部進行評分。我們將權重空間PTQ公式化為使用定價層輸出誤差的預部署配置選擇。每個可接受的層配置被視為一個具有部署成本的誤差生成器，這會引發層輸出誤差協方差 $\boldsymbolΣ_l(α_l)$，而全精度模型通過下游曲率為該協方差定價，$\widehatρ_l(α_l)=\frac{1}{2}\operatorname{Tr}\left(\widehat{\mathbf{H}}_l\,\widehat{\boldsymbolΣ}_l(α_l)\right)$。這個價格源自全精度到量化的前向KL，其一階項在參考模型中相互抵消。它將重建和對角分數轉化為減少的代理，這些代理去掉了價格因子，而有限格式、碼本、粒度和等效轉換則通過它們引發的協方差和它們支付的成本成為可比較的候選者。然後，跟蹤減少產生了一個校準時間價格表和一個預算價格指導選擇器，使固定幾何位元分配成為一個特例，而不是組織問題。
